intervals.quote: This paper reports on a cavity haloscope search for dark matter axions in the galactic halo in the mass range 2.81–3.31 µeV.

summary.plain: The international group of scientists who run the ADMX axion dark-matter search at the University of Washington.
summary.technical: Multi-institution collaboration operating the ADMX Gen 2 haloscope at CENPA, University of Washington, managed by Fermilab.
